title: From AutoResearch to Continual AutoResearch: Do Agents Learn Across Tasks?
summary: Matched persistent and reset agent sessions across nine task families show an empirical efficiency gain that does not consistently carry over to final held-out quality.
ai_technology: LLM research agents with persistent versus reset sessions
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Matched persistent and reset agent sessions across nine task families show an empirical efficiency gain that does not consistently carry over to final held-out quality.
evidence.unknown: Matched task streams and time budgets are used; several model-task comparisons have one run pair, and final-quality gains are inconsistent.
evidence.ai_role: Five frontier agents run matched persistent or reset research sessions with the same tasks, tools, and time limits.
